summary: Appends a 56-byte entry holding a body-frame transformed world position delta plus metadata to a per-object ring buffer, post-incrementing the element count. Called from the vehicle physics joint system loader.

operations.description: Compute append target as buffer base at this+0x230 plus 56 times the post-incremented element count at this+0x22C.
delta.x = a2[0] minus vehicle world position X at this+0x4.
delta.y = a2[1] minus vehicle world position Y at this+0xC.
delta.z = a2[2] minus vehicle world position Z at this+0x14.
Body-frame X = delta dotted with rotation matrix row 0 (this+0x1C, this+0x34, this+0x4C); stored as first double of the entry.
Body-frame Y = delta dotted with rotation matrix row 1 (this+0x24, this+0x3C, this+0x54); stored at entry offset 8.
Body-frame Z = delta dotted with rotation matrix row 2 (this+0x2C, this+0x44, this+0x5C); stored at entry offset 16.
Store metadata dword a3 at entry offset 48 and metadata byte a4 at entry offset 52.
Return the pointer to the appended entry.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the stored metadata dword a3 and byte a4 is not established.
Caller VehiclePhysicsJointSystemLoader passes this as a physics-context object; owner identity is UNKNOWN.
